description: Typologie des ouvrages du système d'endiguement et des secteurs littoraux participant à la cohérence du système de protection PAPI BSA is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. PAPI BSA protection system strategy: Typology of the structures of the containment system and the coastal areas involved in the coherence of the protection system. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Typology of containment system structures and coastal areas involved in the coherence of the PAPI BSA protection system" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include changement climatique, tempête, Risque naturel, modélisation, crue, inondation. The listing shows 2015-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
